subject.title: fix(cli): silent drop of malformed post-core install-records JSON

question: Should post-core update resume abort when the parent plugin install-record handoff is malformed or unreadable, rather than continuing without that recovery snapshot?
rationale: Both behaviors have user impact: continuing can silently discard install-record recovery context, while aborting can leave an update between core installation and plugin convergence or gateway restart. Repository policy requires maintainers to own this fallback and availability tradeoff.

options.title: Accept fail-closed resume
options.body: Land the patch so damaged handoff state stops update resume and operators retry or repair instead of continuing with incomplete recovery context.

options.title: Preserve continuation policy
options.body: Keep continuation possible only with an explicit warning and a maintainer-defined safe reconstruction path for the missing install-record snapshot.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed resume
recommendation.body: Land the patch so damaged handoff state stops update resume and operators retry or repair instead of continuing with incomplete recovery context.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history most directly connects this contributor to the post-core handoff and restart sequencing affected by the decision.
